snippet.title: Garden of Witches - Official Teaser Trailer 3
snippet.description:
We have released a major update that diversifies how you explore the Garden of Witches. 
We’ve expanded combat progression and exploration, adding various game elements that will broaden your tactical choices. 
Experience new rooms, new enemies and spells, the new Imprint System and a completely overhauled combat system!

■ Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2530470
■ Stove : https://store.onstove.com/games/4207
■ Discord : https://discord.com/invite/QG4tJj2QWR

※ This footage is from gameplay currently in development.
